$comment: Single source of truth for resuming ARGIVA work in any agentic editor. Update after every decision or completed task.
rules: Never git commit or git push; leave changes uncommitted for owner review.
Never change product code without explicit owner consent once it exists; report defects and wait.
Never invent policies, prices, certifications, legal or contact details; use docs/brand-content.md or mark TODO(owner).
Config-driven: no hardcoded URLs/domains/business constants; use centralised typed config.
Never ask for or store secrets in this repo; .env.example only.
Ask one topic at a time with options and a recommendation; record each decision here and in sdd/phase-0-discovery.md.

Docs every phase: the last task of each phase plan updates README.md, docs/setup.md (owner accounts/services), docs/runbook.md (operations), a README per new app/package, ADRs and the docs/README.md index; the phase isn't done without it.
awaitingOwner: Review the Phase 2 changes, then commit and push to main yourself (docs/setup.md section 2.5)

GitHub plan: owner chose GitHub Free (2026-10-31). Still to choose: (a) public repo, recommended: everything works as written; (b) private repo: workflows need changes first (STAGING_/PROD_ repo vars, tag push as the production gate, no branch protection). See docs/setup.md section 2.2
Create the Google Cloud project, link billing and set the Rs 500 budget (docs/setup.md sections 2.3 and 3)
Create the Neon project with main and staging branches, and add their URLs to Secret Manager (docs/setup.md sections 4 and 3.8)
Set the GitHub variables, environments and branch protection (docs/setup.md section 5)
Confirm database secrets are stored in Mumbai only (asia-south1), recommended for DPDP

theming.decision: All three moods ship as standalone, switchable themes: quiet-luxury (default), warm-craft, modern-bold
theming.package: packages/design-tokens (@argiva/design-tokens), modelled on linode/design-language-system: DTCG JSON tokens -> Style Dictionary -> CSS custom properties + JS theme registry
theming.tiers: base (shared scales) -> theme palette + semantic tokens (per theme) -> component tokens (shared, reference semantic tokens only)
theming.runtimeSwitch: All themes compiled into one CSS file scoped by [data-theme]; app sets <html data-theme> from a site setting; no rebuild or redeploy to switch
theming.adminControl: Owner-only 'Appearance' setting chooses among registered (built and validated) themes; preview before publish; audit logged. Admins cannot upload raw CSS (prevents CSS injection)
theming.rebrandPipeline: pnpm tokens:new <id> --from <theme> -> edit tokens.json/theme.json -> pnpm tokens:build (validates contract + WCAG contrast, then builds) -> CI workflow design-tokens.yml
theming.ornaments: Theme manifest flags (purityBadge, divider, dividerScope, heroMedia) select signature component variants in the UI package
theming.status: Built and verified 2026-10-31: validate passes for 3 themes (40 semantic tokens, 22 contrast checks each); broken-contrast theme correctly rejected; preview switching verified in browser
theming.commands: npx pnpm@12.16.1 tokens:build | tokens:check | tokens:new <id> --from <theme> (corepack cannot fetch pnpm through the Akamai mirror)
futureAppWork: Admin > Appearance page: Owner-only permission 'settings.appearance', preview via admin-only ?previewTheme=, publish + audit log
Load only the active theme's fonts (manifest.fonts) via self-hosting
UI components read only --argiva-* variables; lint rule against hex literals in components
